blocks.text: SUBIC BAY FREEPORT — An aircraft maintenance facility based at the Subic Freeport has expanded its capacity to accommodate more business jets with the inauguration of a new 7,000-square-meter hangar at the Subic Bay International Airport (SBIA). Aviation Concepts Technical Services, Inc. (ACTSI) inaugurated Hangar B last week, according to the Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority
